title: Ungatshatiwe — Ukuthetha Ntoni Nendlela Yokubhena Ukwaliwa Kwesibonelelo SeSASSA
description: Isimo sesibonelelo sakho seSASSA sibonisa 'uNqatshelwe' — nantsi into ethethwa kuko, ezona zizathu zixhaphakileyo zokwaliwa, kunye nesikhokelo esipheleleyo sokubhena isibonelelo sakho esingatshatiweyo.

seo.metaTitle: Isimo SeSASSA Singatshatiwe? Indlela Yokubhena Kwiintsuku Ezi-90 (2026)
seo.metaDescription: Isimo seSASSA 'siNqatshelwe' ngo-2026? Funda isizathu, uze ubhene kwiintsuku ezi-90 ngesikhokelo sethu esinganyathelo-nyathelo seITSAA.

contentBlocks.title: Ungatshatiwe — Isikhokelo Sakho Sokubhena
contentBlocks.description: Isibonelelo sakho seSASSA singatshatiwe — unelungelo lokubhena. Fumanisa ezona zizathu zixhaphakileyo zokwaliwa, ixesha lakho lokubhena leentsuku ezi-90, kunye nesikhokelo esinganyathelo-nyathelo sokungenisa isibheno esiphumelelayo kwiNkundla Ezimeleyo.

contentBlocks.text: Ungatshatiwe — Ukuthetha Ntoni Kwisibonelelo Sakho SeSASSA

Ukubona 'uNqatshelwe' kukhangelo lwakho lwesimo seSASSA kunokuba nzima, kodwa asikokuphela kwendlela. Isimo sokwaliwa sithetha ukuba iinkqubo ezizenzekelayo zeSASSA ziye zagqiba ukuba awuhlangabezani neemfuno zokufaneleka kwinyanga evavanywayo. Inyanga nganye ivavanywa ngokwahlukileyo, kwaye unelungelo elisemthethweni lokubhena inyanga nganye engatshatiweyo.
Esi simo sichaphazela abafaki-zicelo izicelo zabo zezibonelelo zeSASSA ezingazange zihlangabezane neemfuno zokuphambiwa emva kokuphononongwa.

contentBlocks.explanation: Isimo 'sokuNqatshelwa' sithetha ukuba iinkqubo zokuqinisekisa zeSASSA ziye zajonga isicelo sakho ngokweemfuno zabo zokufaneleka zaza zafumana isizathu sokungasamkeli isicelo sakho kuloo nyanga. I-SASSA ijonga iidathabhese ezininzi kuquka iHome Affairs, iSebe Lezemisebenzi, iSARS, iNSFAS, kunye neakhawunti yakho yebhanki. Ukwaliwa kwinyanga enye akuthethi ukuba awunakufaneleka kwiinyanga ezizayo.
whyItHappens: Umthombo wemali ongomnye ufunyenwe: iifakelo zebhanki zigqibile umda wenyanga weR624
Ubhaliso lwe-UIF lufunyenwe: isazisi sakho sisanxulunyaniswa nerekhodi le-UIF esebenzayo
Inkxaso ye-NSFAS ifunyenwe: isazisi sakho sibhaliswe njengomfundi we-NSFAS osebenzayo
Uvavanyo lweendlela zobomi lusilele: umvuzo wakho okanye iimpahla zakho zigqitha kwimida esemthethweni
Ukuqinisekiswa kwebhanki kusilele: iinkcukacha zakho zebhanki azikwazanga ukuqinisekiswa
Ukuqinisekiswa kwesazisi kusilele: iinkcukacha zesazisi sakho azihambelani neerekhodi zeHome Affairs
Uthunyelwe kuphando lwezityholo: isicelo sakho saphawulwa ngenxa yokungaqhelekanga
Isicelo esiphindiweyo sifunyenwe: kungeniswe isicelo esingaphezu kwenye phantsi kwesazisi sakho
contentBlocks.howLongItLasts: Isimo sokwaliwa sisebenza kumjikelo wenyanga enye kuphela. Inyanga elandelayo ivavanywa njengesicelo esitsha. Nangona kunjalo, ukuba ingxaki ephantsi (umzekelo, ubhaliso lwe-UIF okanye iifakelo zebhanki) isaqhubeka, usenokwaliwa kwakhona.
whatYouShouldDo: Jonga isaziso sakho sokwaliwa ukuze ubone ikhowudi yesizathu ethile
Ukuba ukholelwa ukuba ukwaliwa akuchanekanga, faka isibheno kwiintsuku ezi-90
Kukwaliwa okunxulumene ne-UIF: fumana ileta yokupheliswa kwe-UI-19 kwiSebe Lezemisebenzi
Kukwaliwa okunxulumene ne-NSFAS: cela ileta yokurhoxiswa kwi-myNSFAS
Kukwaliwa ngenxa yomthombo wemali: lungiselela isifungo esibhaliweyo esichaza iifakelo zebhanki
Kwiingxaki zesazisi: tyeleta iHome Affairs ukuze ulungise iinkcukacha zakho
Bhena inyanga nganye engatshatiweyo ngokwahlukileyo kwi-srd.dsd.gov.za

contentBlocks.title: Unemini Eziyi-90 Zokubhena
contentBlocks.text: Umthetho waseMzantsi Afrika ukunika iintsuku eziyi-90 ukususela kumhla wokufumana isaziso sakho sokwaliwa ukuba ufaké isibheno. Izibheno ziphathwa yi-Independent Tribunal for Social Assistance Appeals (ITSAA), ehlukile ngokupheleleyo kwiSASSA. Awudingi ggqwetha ukuba ubhene.

faqs.question: Ngaba ndingafaka isicelo esitsha endaweni yokubhena?
faqs.answer: Ewe, ungafaka isicelo esitsha nanini na. Nangona kunjalo, ukuba isizathu sokwaliwa sisahleli (umzekelo, ubhaliso lwe-UIF), usenokwaliwa kwakhona. Bhena okanye ulungise ingxaki ephantsi kuqala.

faqs.question: Ngaba kufuneka ndibhene inyanga ngenyanga?
faqs.answer: Ewe. Ngenxa yokuba iSASSA ivavanya ukufaneleka ngenyanga, kufuneka ubhene inyanga nganye ebonisa isimo 'sokuNqatshelwa'.

faqs.question: Kuthetha ntoni ukuba ndiphose ixesha lokubhena leentsuku eziyi-90?
faqs.answer: Ngelishwa, izibheno azinakwamkelwa emva kweentsuku eziyi-90. Kufuneka ufake isicelo esitsha siphelele sezibonelelo.

faqs.question: Ngaba ndingabhena ngobuqu kwi-ofisi yeSASSA?
faqs.answer: Ewe. Kwizibonelelo ezingezizo ze-SRD, ungatyelela i-ofisi yeSASSA namaxwebhu akho uze ucele ukuba kungeniswe isibheno ngesandla. Kwi-SRD, izibheno ziphethwa ikakhulu kwi-intanethi kwi-srd.dsd.gov.za.

faqs.question: Kuthatha ixesha elingakanani inkqubo yokubhena?
faqs.answer: Ngokuqhelekileyo inkundla ithatha iintsuku ezingama-60 ukuya kwezingama-90 ukukhupha isigqibo. Ukuba kuvunyiwe, iSASSA kufuneka ihlawule iimali ezibuyiselwayo kwiintsuku eziyi-14 zomsebenzi.
